title: Credit line, window rise, sidebar zoom
summary: A two-word credit line on white hands over to a rounded app window that rises from below, a two-word title lands above it, then the camera snaps in on the window's sidebar menu and holds so every item can be read.
use_when: Announcing one navigation or menu change inside an existing chat or app UI
A short silent teaser that ends on a readable UI detail instead of a logo
Light, restrained product voice with one camera move
Opening shot of a longer UI walkthrough

look.type_style: geometric sans, regular weight, sentence case, normal tracking; credit line ~3.5 % H, title ~8 % H centred above the window

sfx.event: app window rises in from the bottom edge
title words close their gap and settle
camera snaps in on the sidebar

structure.shot: credit line, 2 words (maker + role), small and centred on flat white
structure.camera: push-in ~1.00->1.02 over 60 fr (motion.json 1.2 %/s in second 0, 0.3 %/s in second 1)
structure.motion: fade in from grey at 0.27 s to full black by 0.50 s (~8-15 fr, easings.outQuint suggested, ±0.25 s); holds; text shrinks slightly by 1.77 s as the window starts to come

structure.shot: rounded app window with sidebar menu, centre greeting and prompt field rises from the bottom; credit line slides down behind it and is gone
structure.motion: window translate-y from ~55 % H below to rest at ~1/3 H in <= 8 fr (2.00 half-in and faint, 2.27 settled; springs.layout, overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s) with an opacity ramp; credit exits down with the window

structure.shot: title above the window, 2 words: product name + the feature noun; window holds with the prompt field visible
structure.motion: title fades in grey with a wide word gap at 2.77 s and closes to normal spacing, full contrast by 3.00 s (~7 fr, easings.outExpo suggested, ±0.25 s); holds 23 fr

structure.shot: camera moves from the full window to the sidebar menu region; title leaves up out of frame
structure.camera: zoom-tier full -> region: sidebar width 218 px -> 356 px of 1280 (x1.63), pan up-left, settled by 4.27 s; springs.cameraIn, 15 fr (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: title moves up with the camera and fades out; window content does not animate

structure.shot: close framing on the sidebar: app name row, 9 menu items with icons, one tag chip, lower items fading to white; prompt field edge at bottom right
structure.camera: static (motion.json pan 0, zoom 0.01-0.02 %/s from 5 s on)
structure.motion: settle tail of the camera spring inside second 4 (motion.json 'animation', diff 0.27), then a 166 fr hold with no motion

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, muted, bg
params.content.credit: 2-word credit line before the reveal (maker + role)
params.content.title: 2-word title above the window: product name + feature noun
params.content.sidebar: 8-10 menu items {label, icon, tag?}; the zoom lands on this list
params.content.greeting: short centre greeting and prompt placeholder inside the window
params.timing.zoomAt: frame of the sidebar zoom at 30 fps (default 113)
params.timing.hold: frames the final sidebar framing holds (default 166)

notes: One shot, 0 cuts, silent: all sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured. Timings from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); spring names and entrance frame counts are suggested defaults, overshoot not measurable. Zoom factor x1.63 measured on keyframes 3.50 and 5.50 (sidebar width). The last 5.5 s is a pure hold: shorten timing.hold for social feeds. The prompt field is shown idle (no typing). Proposed term: word-gap-close (title words start apart and slide together), not in the vocabulary. Catalogue hint 'glow' not visible on the sheets.
